verdict.rationale: First-party docs state the core is open source at github.com/plastic-labs/honcho and can be self-hosted, and llms.txt describes Honcho as an open-source memory layer; the public GitHub repo is cited directly. The 'core' qualifier suggests some components may not be open. Missing for 10: the specific license is never named, it is unclear which non-core parts are excluded, and there is no independent confirmation of license terms.
